svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.15.4 Direction of Installation
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION

g.text: Plywood: surface grain at right angles to the
joists, joints parallel to joists staggered, (1)
OSB (CSA O325, O-1 or O-2) and waferboard (R-1):
face orientation at right angles to the joists,
joints parallel to the joists staggered, (2)

svg.text: Plywood subflooring is installed with the
surface grain at right angles to the joists
and with joints parallel to floor joists
OSB subflooring conforming to CSA O325,
"Construction sheathing," or to O-1 and O-2
grades in CSA O437.0, "OSB and Waferboard,"
and waferboard subflooring conforming to R-1
grade in CSA O437.0 are installed so that the
direction of face orientation is at right
angles to the joists and the joints parallel
to the floor joists are staggered. (See Note
Drawn: red arrows show the grain or face orientation, red dashes the end joints. Panel layout is illustration only.
